# Minor TagHelper refactoring

Minor refactoring to MVC Tag Helper related code.

## Description

- Use `for` loop for field that is an array, rather than typing as an `IEnumerable<T>` and using `foreach`.
- Remove two dictionary lookups where the value is already present in a local variable from [a call to `TryGetValue()`](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/81cb87e31c66785b64dbc78b01d4f31c80d7ac17/src/Mvc/Mvc.TagHelpers/src/TagHelperOutputExtensions.cs#L241).
- Set `SkipEnabledCheck` to true for two log statements that are already guarded with an `IsEnabled(LogLevel.Debug)` check.
- Use the same implementation to check for whitespace in `GlobbingUrlBuilder` as in [`UrlResolutionTagHelper`](https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/81cb87e31c66785b64dbc78b01d4f31c80d7ac17/src/Mvc/Mvc.Razor/src/TagHelpers/UrlResolutionTagHelper.cs#L341-L344).
- Seal internal and private classes where appropriate.
- Use a `char` overload for `string.Join()`.
- Use target-typed new expression with field initializers.
- Use `is` patterns in a few places instead of `as` and a null check.
- Fix some whitespace issues from introduction of file-scoped namespaces.
- Use `ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull()` where appropriate in files I touched to make the other changes above.
title: Minor TagHelper refactoring
